accounting_limits: Actual file/process checkpoints only. No complete measurement of prior conversation, internal model calls, tokens or all tool calls.

checks.scope: Source commit and all manifested source bytes/size/lines; not live freshness.
Findings have reasons, preserved outcomes, proposals, references, unique IDs and report counterparts.
178 evidence/role references have valid ranges and exact anchor excerpts; semantic support is reviewed separately.
All declared Markdown dispositions and primary roles; line partitions are structural coverage, not a semantic-completeness score.
Protected source bytes unchanged and run output allowlist; full remote tree diff is checked separately on publication.
Human report has no code/JSON fences, balanced details, pinned source links and decision boundary labels; no live external link check.
84 independent Python AST parses and bounded mock execution are separated from actual LLM/E2E/training claims and unknown usage.
Attempt cap, changes and actual checkpoint accounting; this script does not implement a Runner or enforce model deadlines.
